verdicts.decision_note: The source identifies a material unresolved sizing rule: whether the model should target DSCR alone or both DSCR and equity IRR.

value_updates.sizing_criteria: Size the availability payment to meet both the minimum DSCR and minimum equity IRR thresholds.
value_updates.dscr_only_constraint: Do not size solely to DSCR when doing so produces negative equity returns.

verdicts.decision_note: The client sets executable DSCR and equity-IRR sizing criteria. The separate CCA instruction affects tax modeling but is not explicitly established as an availability-payment-sizing attribute.
